primitives.name: Serve Reception Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: The aim of the study was to identify mapping models of effective cooperation in the game, in the game positioning phase – in the element of receiving-passing the ball (serves).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes optimal player positioning and reactive coordination under pressure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collapses when server's velocity exceeds receiver reaction threshold.

layer2.mapping: Maps serve trajectories to receiver response manifolds via probabilistic conformal inference.
layer2.telemetry: Ball exit velocity relative to receiver reaction time

primitives.name: Cooperation Spatial Flexibility
primitives.verbatim_quote: Each team has a specific model of receiving-passing the ball (serve) due to the spatial flexibility.
primitives.assumptions: Operates under the premise of dynamic field geometry and adaptive player roles.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates when spatial constraints eliminate viable passing angles.

layer2.mapping: Encodes spatial adaptability as a state-transition graph over court quadrants.

primitives.name: Efficiency Analysis
primitives.verbatim_quote: The analysis covers different elements like: players motor skills, psychological and mental sphere, but most of all – their efficiency in the game.
primitives.assumptions: Treats performance as a composite function of physical, cognitive, and tactical variables.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when any single variable drops below tournament-standard thresholds.

layer2.mapping: Quantifies efficiency as a weighted sum of skill metrics calibrated against match outcomes.
layer2.telemetry: Match outcome probability conditioned on skill metric deviations
